  curve: "q025"
  taxa: "mammals_birds"

  cells_to_remove_per_iteration: 1000
  pruning_iterations_per_stage: 100
  rank_method: "abf"

  species_csv: "Data/Clean/species_table.csv"
  ana_subdir: "ana"

  pipe_patch_lookup_dir: "patch_lookup_tables"

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Compare pipeline and benchmark persistence curves and write stage/species/PU
# metrics for a completed script-6 priority run and script-7.2 rank LUTs.
if (requireNamespace("knitr", quietly = TRUE)) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
}
```

```{r run_persistence_comparison, fig.width=7, fig.height=6}
stage7_compare_env <- knitr::knit_global()

source_stage7_compare_file <- function(path, quiet = TRUE) {
  run_source <- function() {
    source(path, local = stage7_compare_env, print.eval = !isTRUE(quiet))
  }

  if (isTRUE(quiet)) {
    invisible(capture.output(run_source(), type = "output"))
  } else {
    run_source()
  }

  invisible(NULL)
}

source_stage7_compare_file(file.path("R", "stage7_persistence_compare_core.R"), quiet = TRUE)
source_stage7_compare_file(file.path("R", "stage7_persistence_compare_stats.R"), quiet = TRUE)

illustrative_species <- params$illustrative_species
if (is.null(illustrative_species) || !length(illustrative_species)) {
  illustrative_species <- params$focus_species
}
illustrative_species <- unique(as.character(unlist(illustrative_species)))
illustrative_species <- illustrative_species[nzchar(trimws(illustrative_species))]

if (!length(illustrative_species)) {
  stop("params$illustrative_species must contain at least one species name.")
}

original_focus_species <- params$focus_species

for (species_index in seq_along(illustrative_species)) {
  params$focus_species <- illustrative_species[[species_index]]

  source_stage7_compare_file(file.path("R", "stage7_persistence_compare_figures.R"), quiet = TRUE)

  if (species_index == 1L) {
    source_stage7_compare_file(file.path("R", "stage7_persistence_compare_report.R"), quiet = FALSE)
  }

  if (exists("fig_cmp_4panel", envir = stage7_compare_env, inherits = FALSE)) {
    source(file.path("R", "figure_utils.R"), local = stage7_compare_env)
    figure <- get("fig_cmp_4panel", envir = stage7_compare_env, inherits = FALSE)

    if (species_index == 1L) {
      save_manuscript_figure(figure, "persistence_comparison")
    }

    cat("\n\n### ", params$focus_species, "\n\n", sep = "")
    print(figure)
  }
}

params$focus_species <- original_focus_species
```
